title: Maximum Score From Removing Substrings
summary: Given a string s and integers x and y, you can remove occurrences of 'ab' to earn x points or 'ba' to earn y points.
statement: Given a string s and integers x and y, you can remove occurrences of 'ab' to earn x points or 'ba' to earn y points. Calculate the maximum points you can earn by performing these operations any number of times.
constraints: Removing substring ab earns x points and removing ba earns y points; removals close the remaining characters together.
Return the maximum total after any sequence of removals.
hints: Only runs over a and b interact; when pairs overlap, the higher-valued orientation should be removed first.
Use a stack pass for the higher score, then another for the lower score.
Pop when stack top plus current character equals the active pair; retain all other characters.
An exchange argument moves every available higher-valued overlapping removal before a lower one without reducing the number of later removals.
editorial: An exchange argument moves every available higher-valued overlapping removal before a lower one without reducing the number of later removals.

tests.explanation: Removing the higher-valued ba pairs first and then ab pairs earns nineteen.
Prioritizing ab earns twenty points across the independent letter blocks.
